items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: I stayed with Louis until '64... Joe Glazer got so mad with me... because he wanted to give me more money.

ctx.x: So, yeah, I stayed with Louis until '64, and this is -- well, I knew my wife was sick, but I didn't know what was wrong with her. I'd bought a home in the meantime here in Los Angeles, and her and my daughter were living here. So I just would commute. You know, when I had told you how much time you get off with Louis, you know. I would come back and visit, and so finally when I found my wife was sick, I left the band, and Joe Glazer got so mad with me, he hardly spoke to me, you know, about that, because he…

I said, no, I got to go home. My wife is sick. And so it's a good thing I did because I found out my wife had cancer, and we caught it, you know, just in time. She went out to this White Memorial Hospital out here, and I used to take her out there for cobalt treatments.
